_note: Where jev-drive may run. Jev (TypeSafe) and the takeover model receive each page's visible text, so list only public pages. Each host maps to a regular expression its URL path must match; anything else (order history, account, cart, checkout, addresses, payments) stops the run before the page is sent. Amazon is limited to its home, search, browse, brand-store and product pages; they can still show the signed-in first name and delivery area. Never add banking, email, insurance-carrier, CRM, school or government sites.
